prompt:
The workspace evals/out/03-spec-carries-questions/ws/ holds intent.md. Treat it as accepted: it was merged to main at 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567. Read .claude/skills/design-spec/SKILL.md and templates/spec.md, then write spec.md in the same workspace.

Rules: (1) every open question of the intent (Q1, Q2) appears under `## Open questions from intent` as `- Q1 answered: …` or `- Q1 carried forward: … (owner)` — none dropped; (2) every constraint of the intent (C1, C2) is restated under `## Constraints`; (3) leave no ‹…› placeholder; (4) line 2 is `Upstream: intent.md@<sha>. Status: draft.`
expected_output: One spec.md: Q1 and Q2 each appear as answered: or carried forward:, C1 and C2 are restated, no placeholder left, Status: draft.
measures: Whether L3 270 — 'are the open questions from intent.md answered or carried forward?' — holds as behaviour. A dropped question breaks the chain silently.
assertions: Each carried-forward question names an owner
Each acceptance criterion names the requirement it covers (AC → R)
Flagged concerns is not empty, or says 'none — reason'
